//: The workforce's portable tools, in the neutral shape every API wraps its own way: a name, a description and a JSON Schema object of parameters. They keep to the subset OpenAI (strict mode included), xAI, Anthropic, Gemini and MCP all accept: an object root, every parameter required, additionalProperties false, string enums only, and an empty string where a value is optional. The host that runs the agents implements each one.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message envelope to another agent. The host delivers it only to an agent in the sender's may_message list, so a request for another department goes to the Chief of Staff.

venture.description: The venture this is for: its folder name under Ventures/ in the owner's vault, personal for the owner's own life, or workforce for work on the workforce itself. A task the owner frames across ventures names each one, separated by commas.

thread.description: The id of the request this message belongs to; empty for a new request.

context.description: Everything the receiver needs, restated, never 'see above'.

ask.description: One task, starting with a verb; empty for a notice.

done_when.description: The check that proves the task is finished.

due.description: The due date as YYYY-MM-DD; empty when there is none.

gate.description: owner when the work waits on the owner's yes.

state.description: The task's state as of this message.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from the agent's workspace.

path.description: The file's path in the workspace.

tools.name: search_vault
tools.description: Search the owner's knowledge vault and return matching notes with their paths and dates.

folder.description: A vault folder to search within; empty for the whole vault.

tools.name: read_vault
tools.description: Read one note from the owner's knowledge vault.

path.description: The note's path from the vault root.

tools.name: write_vault
tools.description: Write a note into the owner's knowledge vault and commit it. Only the Knowledge Vault Manager holds this tool.

path.description: The note's path from the vault root.

message.description: The commit message, as type(scope): subject.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or replace a file in the agent's workspace, never in the vault.

path.description: The file's path in the workspace.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch one public web page as text.

tools.name: run_code
tools.description: Run code in the host's sandbox and return its output.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task or reminder in the owner's task list.

title.description: What is to be done, starting with a verb.

venture.description: The venture this is for: its folder name under Ventures/ in the owner's vault, personal for the owner's own life, or workforce for work on the workforce itself.

owner.description: The agent id or 'owner' who does it.

due.description: The due date as YYYY-MM-DD; empty when there is none.

remind_at.description: When to remind, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with the owner's time zone; empty for no reminder.

owner.description: An agent id or 'owner'; empty for everyone.

due_before.description: Only tasks due before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD; empty for all.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List the owner's calendar events in a window.

tools.name: propose_event
tools.description: Propose a calendar event. It is held for the owner's yes and never added or sent by itself.

attendees.description: Email addresses to invite; empty for a private block.

why.description: What the time is for, and what it serves.

tools.name: search_mail
tools.description: Search the owner's mail and return matching messages.

tools.name: draft_mail
tools.description: Save a draft email for the owner to review. It is never sent by this tool.

reply_to.description: The id of the message this replies to; empty for a new message.

tools.name: request_owner_approval
tools.description: Ask the owner to approve a gated act and wait for the answer. Only the Chief of Staff holds this tool.

category.description: Which gate the act falls under.

action.description: Exactly what will be done, by whom, if approved.

details.description: Why, the amounts, parties and dates, and what was checked.
